title: Central Siliguri Heritage & Traditional Loop
description: A classic heritage circuit through the traditional bastions of Central Siliguri, covering Sabeki idols, century-old clubs, and intimate neighborhood celebrations.
tips: Best experienced on foot or by cycle between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM before peak evening rush.
Enjoy authentic Siliguri street snacks like Ghugni and Jhalmuri around Deshbandhupara crossing.
Strict no-vehicle zones apply inside residential alleys of Hakimpara.

title: Eastern Corridor Grand Theme Tour
description: Witness Siliguri’s most breathtaking blockbuster theme pandals along the eastern artery and Sevoke Road corridor, featuring monumental structures and laser illuminations.
tips: Take two-wheelers or battery e-rickshaws (Toto) as car parking along Sevoke Road is restricted.
Peak illumination lighting starts after 6:30 PM.
Check police diversions near Panitanki traffic point before entering Haiderpara.
highlight: Spectacular lighting and modern thematic architecture

title: North Junction Accessible Family Express
description: Designed specifically for families with elders and young children, focusing on wide approach roads, designated parking hubs, and easy pedestrian walkways.
tips: Dedicated parking grounds available near Champasari High School grounds.
Wheelchair friendly entrance corridors available at Uttar Mallaguri.
Ideal time for family visits is late morning (11 AM - 3 PM) or early dusk.
highlight: Senior-friendly approaches, wide lanes and open spaces
